claims.claim: Salesforce's Agentforce and Data 360 ARR reached nearly $3.9B, up more than 210% year over year, while Agentforce ARR exceeded $1.5B and 7.0B agentic work units had been delivered, indicating measurable enterprise-agent adoption beyond pilot scale.
Salesforce completed its acquisition of Fin on September 10, adding an AI customer-agent platform and an established base of more than 30,000 companies.

risks.risk: Reported AI ARR includes evolving product definitions and acquisitions, so organic durability and incremental economics require separation.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental gross margin and retention of Agentforce-specific revenue are not isolated in the release.

claims.claim: Fiscal Q2 2027 revenue was $11.3B, up 11% year over year; cRPO rose 14% constant currency, operating cash flow rose 71%, free cash flow rose 81%, and Salesforce raised FY27 revenue guidance to $46.1B-$46.4B.

risks.risk: Reported growth includes Informatica contribution and updated guidance includes pending acquisitions, complicating organic-growth interpretation.

contradictions.contradiction: Headline 11%-12% FY27 growth guidance includes acquisition contribution; management separately described only $100M of the guidance raise as organic growth.

unknowns.unknown: Post-acquisition integration economics for Informatica, Fin and Contentful remain unproven.
